//: Baked into /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json in the devbox image. SessionStart runs `lab brief`: it syncs the org's skill library into ~/.claude/skills (lab skills → GET /api/runs/:ref/skills with the lab envelope and the run's LAB_RUN_TOKEN; every published runbook as a Claude Code skill, one verified copy, skipped when its sha is unchanged) and prints this run's frozen session brief (GET /api/runs/:ref/brief): the task, the project, the decisions that bind it, the skills on this box and one line pointing at the org's skills. SessionEnd runs `lab keep`: each tool the run kept in .lab/keep/<rb-name>/ (SKILL.md + scripts/ + data/) is proposed, files included, for a person to review — nothing reaches the library unreviewed. Outside a dispatched run both say there is nothing to do. `lab` (signal|remember|consult|applied|propose|keep|skills|runbook|recall) is documented in the CLI itself. permissions: the allowlist that replaced --dangerously-skip-permissions (docs/microvm-runner-design.md §14 step 2). Managed settings cannot be widened by a repository's .claude/settings.json, deny wins over allow, and in -p mode a call no rule allows is refused and reported to the model. Bypass mode is disabled so no flag can turn the lists off.
